title: CP/M-80 software — libre demos (Z80)
notes: Libre CP/M 2.2 programs written for BrickWright. A .COM loads at 0x0100 on the Z80 machine's CP/M layer and runs interactively (BDOS behind CALL 5) — the same path lite boots BBC BASIC on. `sieve.com` is the flagship: a real SDCC-compiled C program that prints the primes below 50 via BDOS function 2. `hello.com` is a minimal pasmo-assembled greeting via BDOS function 9. To run a different program, put its .COM in the `com` slot. Rebuild both from source with build.sh (pasmo + sdcc). These are CP/M 2.2 programs: they also run on the real CCP+BDOS boot (bw-board scripts/cpm-smoke.mjs, DRI's redistributable CP/M 2.2).
